Name: Pond Added To Farm
Author: tikamin557
Description:
All default settings are disabled.
Use "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url]﻿" to check the coordinates of the location where you want to place it, and then activate the settings from the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿".

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Compatibility with custom farm map mods.[/size][/color]
Both "custom farm mods that override vanilla farm types" and "custom farm mods that add a new type of farm" are compatible with most of them and by default.
However, depending on the order in which the mods are loaded and the way the "custom farm mod to add a new type of farm" is added (code), the pond may not be installed correctly.
If you have set it up correctly and the pond is not installed, please report the custom farm mod you are using on the POSTS page.

"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28885]Fill The Pond[/url]" allows you to hide individual ponds that are in place by default.
You can also use this mod to place a new pond of any size in the location where you have hidden the pond.


Currently supported in English and Japanese and French.
